name: Marquis Los Cabos
positioning: Adults-only, all-inclusive resort of suites facing the ocean on the Los Cabos Touristic Corridor, between San Jose del Cabo and Cabo San Lucas (officially Marquis Los Cabos Resort & Spa)
best_for: Adult couples who want an all-inclusive stay with ocean-facing suites
Golfers who want to play the Cabo Real, Puerto Los Cabos or Club Campestre de San Jose courses
Travelers who want winter whale sightings from their suite

facts.text: Marquis Los Cabos is an adults' resort: all guests must be above 18 to check in.
The resort sits on the Touristic Corridor, a 15-minute drive from downtown San Jose del Cabo and a 20-minute drive from downtown Cabo San Lucas.
Los Cabos Airport (SJD) is a 35-minute drive from the resort.
Marquis Los Cabos opened on April 6, 2003.
The resort has two infinity pools and one central pool.
The all-inclusive plan includes premium liquor brands, 24/7 suite service, a daily refreshed minibar, Molton Brown toiletries, parking and Wi-Fi.
Condé Nast Traveler notes each suite has a hot tub, a furnished balcony and views of the Sea of Cortez.
Spa Marquis offers treatments including hydrotherapy circuits and treatments with Natura Bisse.
The resort displays a private collection of works by Latin American artists, including Mexican artist Jorge Marin, whose signature material is bronze.
Thursdays feature a live rock band and a fire show by the Central Pool.
Fridays bring a Mexican Night with live mariachi and a Mexican buffet at the Central Pool.
A desalination system converts seawater to meet all of the resort's hygiene water needs.

highlights.text: All suites face the ocean, and in winter whales can often be seen in the morning.
Each of the Casitas has its own plunge pool.
Bali beds along the edge of the infinity pools can be reserved as private cabanas looking over the Sea of Cortez.
Marquis guests get a preferential green tee on the Cabo Real, Puerto Los Cabos and Club Campestre de San Jose golf courses.
Sunset private dining is a candlelit four-course dinner for two paired with a bottle of Louis Roederer champagne.

considerations.text: The resort's beach is not swimmable because the waves are very strong; a swimmable beach is about a 7-minute walk away.
Spa treatments are not included in the all-inclusive plan.
Dining at Canto del Mar carries an additional fee per person.
